description: Actual fourdql --html output rendered in a browser (macOS WKWebView) in light appearance, not terminal screenshots. There are 16 canonical file types; .data is an alias of .4DD and shares data-file.png. Generated HTML provides its script-free browser controls, not native Quick Look continuous gestures. Synthetic means hand-constructed example/test content, not production user data. Native-export fixtures are also test data, but were serialized by 4D. See each provenance. Sizes are CSS pixels; output PNGs are normalized to 1x. Pages remain unmodified. Short source/metadata pages use shorter viewports to avoid blank padding; long document previews show their initial viewport.
scratchNote: Set CLI_SCREENSHOT_SCRATCH to a persistent session files directory, never /tmp. Requires macOS, swiftc, Python 3, and .build/debug/fourdql (or --cli PATH).
validation: The regeneration script checks generated HTML and rendered page text for failure reports rather than trusting CLI exit status. It waits for fonts and embedded images, verifies light appearance, and validates PNG signatures, dimensions, chunk checksums, decompression and nonblank content.
